name: image_compress
title: Image Compress
description: Compress images with adjustable quality using the Caesium engine. Supports batch compression, overwrite or output to a custom folder.

items.description: The image files to be compressed

image_files.description: The image files to be compressed

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite the original image file

quality.description: The quality of the image. The higher the value is, better the result will be,Allowed range is [0. 100], default is 80

max_size.description: Target maximum file size in bytes (e.g., 512000 for 500KB). When set, quality is ignored and the compressor will try to fit the image within this size.

width.description: Resize to specific width in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

height.description: Resize to specific height in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)

long_edge.description: Resize by longest edge in pixels. Useful for mixed portrait/landscape batches — every image gets the same maximum dimension regardless of orientation.

short_edge.description: Resize by shortest edge in pixels (maintains aspect ratio)
